en.headline: Firefighters extinguish Fanling warehouse blaze after nearly two hours
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the fire at a Ping Che Road warehouse was largely put out by 9:58pm, with damping-down continuing and no injuries reported.
body: The Fire Services Department received multiple reports at about 8:18pm on Friday of a fire at a warehouse on Ping Che Road in Fanling. Firefighters responded with breathing apparatus teams and hose lines and brought the blaze largely under control by 9:58pm.

According to the department, a damping-down and ventilation operation continued afterwards. Two people were rescued from the scene and were not injured. The department later issued a special announcement advising residents affected by drifting smoke and an unusual odour to stay indoors, close doors and windows, and remain calm.

Residents in nearby villages and as far as Sheung Shui reported a strong burning-plastic smell carried by the wind. Some areas experienced temporary power interruptions during the incident. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 粉嶺坪輋路貨倉火警近兩小時救熄 無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處表示，晚上約9時58分將火勢大致救熄，其後進行降溫及散煙，並救出兩名市民，均無受傷。
body: 消防處周五晚上約8時18分接獲多宗報案，指粉嶺坪輋路一個貨倉起火。消防派出煙帽隊及拖喉灌救，至晚上約9時58分將火勢大致救熄。
消防處表示，其後進行降溫及散煙行動。現場救出兩名市民，他們並無受傷。消防處其後發出特別通告，呼籲受隨風飄散的煙霧及異味影響的市民關閉門窗及保持鎮定。
附近村落及上水一帶有居民表示聞到濃烈燒膠味。有地區一度短暫停電。起火原因仍在調查中。
